name: transition-route-slide
title: Route Slide
description: Bấm vào một dòng, trang cũ và trang chi tiết trượt sang trái như một dải liền; bấm quay lại thì dải chạy ngược đúng đường cũ.

moworks.author: takayu

options.backAt: s after the start to slide back the same way (null: stay)
options.parallax: true: the old page moves only −18 % and dims (the push variant)

credit.author: TakayuStudio (motion-reference)
credit.licence: No licence stated: idea and numbers only
credit.madeNote: written here from the idea and its numbers; none of the source's code

moworks.notes: Idea and numbers (TakayuStudio route-slide, written here): Window 200x136. Old page x 0 → −100 % and new page x 100 % → 0 move as one strip over 600 ms power2.inOut (0.4-1.0 s), a 1 px divider on the new page's left edge. Back reverses the same path (1.9-2.5 s). Cursor clicks a row at 0.3 s and the back arrow at 1.8 s. DOM recipe variant: old x 0 → −18 % with opacity 1 → 0.4 (parallax push). Params: duration (0.6 s) · direction (forward | back) · ease (power2.inOut).
moworks.titleVi: Trang mới trượt vào đẩy trang cũ
